about: Experience the original SENRAN KAGURA Burst, the beginning of the world's best-loved buxom battle series, like never before! Tackle the classic ninja brawler from a whole new perspective in gorgeous, fluid HD, with new features and mechanics throughout!
With fully revamped visuals, the game has evolved from side-scrolling action to free-flowing 3D, rebuilt on an enhanced version of the engine from SENRAN KAGURA ESTIVAL VERSUS.
The original roster of 12 playable characters has been increased to more than 20*, who can be freely customised with an abundance of more than 150 items.

With new Shinobi transformation animations, new story details, and even more ways to destroy opponents' costumes, SENRAN KAGURA Burst Re:Newal is a delightful treat for fans of the series and newcomers alike.
*Some additional characters available as paid DLC.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience the original SENRAN KAGURA Burst, the beginning of the world's best-loved buxom battle series, like never before!
